rationale: The digest shows a massive +216.8% spike in currencyservice_mem (z=+43.35) alongside a +103.7% increase in currencyservice_socket, indicating severe memory exhaustion. Traces confirm currencyservice as the bottleneck in the frontendservice -> currencyservice -> productcatalogservice path, causing ~8s latency and upstream errors.

proposed_fix.description: Increase memory limits for the currencyservice deployment and restart its pods to clear exhausted memory and socket connections, while investigating potential memory leaks or unbounded caches.
